title: Exact analytical PGSE signal for diffusion confined to a cylindrical surface using a spectral Laplacian formalism
summary: Objective. To derive an exact analytical expression for the diffusion MRI signal arising from diffusion confined to a cylindrical surface under finite rectangular pulsed-gradient spin-echo (PGSE) gradients, and to develop computationally efficient strategies for repeated model evaluations. Approach. The Bloch-Torrey equation was solved using a spectral matrix formalism of the Laplace operator in the eigenbasis of the cylindrical surface.
